title: Minimum second neighborhood degree energy of commuting graphs of finite rings
summary: In this paper, we compute minimum second neighborhood degree spectrum and energy of commuting graphs of certain finite non-commutative rings. In particular, we consider non-commutative rings of order $p^2, p^3, p^4, p^5, p^2q$ and $p^3q$, where $p$ and $q$ are primes. We shall also show that the commuting graphs of these rings are MSN-integral but not MSN-hyperintegral. Finally, employing the techniques used in this paper, we prove Conjecture 3 of [Nath, R.
